description: Kapture CX is an enterprise AI-powered customer experience platform built around agentic AI: voice and non-voice AI agents, observability, and human–AI orchestration for end-to-end support automation. The stack spans self-serve resolution (inbound/outbound voice agents, email/WhatsApp/social automation, real-time monitoring and intervention), an agent suite (advanced ticketing, Customer 360, routing and SLAs, copilot-style assistance for agents, no-code Vitos AI Agent Platform), insights (AI-driven quality audits on 100% of interactions, conversational intelligence, GenAI surveys and feedback), and employee experience (internal service desk, workspaces, AI agents for HR/IT). Positioning highlights training on 1B+ minutes of real conversations, 1000+ enterprise customers, and vertical plays across BFSI, retail and q-commerce, travel, digital-native brands, energy and utilities, and consumer durables. Site compares against Zendesk, Salesforce Service Cloud, and Freshdesk; offers API documentation, integrations hub, and trust/security narrative.
sub_industry: AI contact center, ticketing, and conversational CX platform
